description: Returns triggered compliance controls for a CVE or threat actor across 11 frameworks: NERC CIP, IEC 62443 (2-1/2-4/3-2/3-3/4-2), NIST 800-82, NIST CSF 2.0, CISA CPG, Saudi NCA OTCC, and UAE NESA IA. Deterministic table lookup — LLM only adds compensating control prose. Designed for automated compliance reporting agents: call when a new advisory drops, generate gap report, route to compliance team. Price: $0.04 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired challenge; retry the identical call with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"].

actor.description: Threat actor name e.g. SANDWORM, VOLTZITE, XENOTIME

framework.description: Optional filter to one compliance framework. Omit or pass 'all' to return matches across every framework.

name: getComplianceMapping
title: Multi-Framework Compliance Gap Mapping
